from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """Extracted information about a single paper from the provided collection."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The full title of the paper")
    references_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of the OTHER provided papers that this paper explicitly cites in its bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregation of all parsed papers in the collection."""
    papers: list[Paper]
